plans_note: High Zone L21-L31: 19,000-20,000 sq ft; Low Zone L7-L18: 17,000-18,000 sq ft (landlord figures). Your leased area and tenancy plan come from the leasing team.

sections.heading: Layouts and fit-out ideas
sections.text: Ideas only; check the tenancy plan, landlord fit-out rules and approvals before work.
bullets: Side core keeps the window line free: run workstations and benches along the glazing, put meeting rooms and storage near the cores.
3m ceiling and 150mm raised floor: use the height for cove lighting and acoustic baffles; route power through the floor to built-in desks.
Knock-out panels allow vertical links between floors (landlord feature); any opening needs landlord and authority approval.

sections.heading: Views tips
sections.text: The landlord markets high-zone offices facing Marina Bay and facing the city. No view is guaranteed for any floor or suite: check your actual floor and side (the base plan marks the Beach Road and Nicoll Highway frontages and a north point), then plan glare control and screen positions around it.

faq.q: When did Shaw Tower get TOP?
faq.a: Lendlease announced on 6 July 2026 that Shaw Tower secured its Temporary Occupation Permit. Tenant handover dates are set per lease. ([Lendlease](https://www.lendlease.com/media-centre/media-releases/shaw-tower-secures-temporary-occupation-permit/))

faq.q: How big are the office floors?
faq.a: The landlord lists High Zone (L21-L31) at 19,000-20,000 sq ft and Low Zone (L7-L18) at 17,000-18,000 sq ft, with 3m floor-to-ceiling height. ([Shaw Tower plans](https://shawtower.com.sg/plans/))

faq.q: What are the concepts based on?
faq.a: The landlord's published side-core floor plate and typical high-zone test fit. They are style concepts, not your actual office.

faq.q: Where do I get my exact floor plan?
faq.a: From the Shaw Tower leasing team; the public site shows base plans and an example test fit only.

faq.q: Do I need approval for an office fit-out?
faq.a: Yes, landlord consent, and SCDF plan approval where works affect fire safety such as escape routes. A qualified person classifies the works. ([SCDF plan approval](https://www.scdf.gov.sg/fire-safety-services-listing/plans-submission-process/plan-approval))

cta_text: WhatsApp Maison with your floor, area, headcount and move-in date.
